outcome_evidence: The drawer is initially closed (frame 0, image and left_ego_image). The robot approaches and aligns with its handle, with close alignment visible at frames 85–103 in wrist_image. The drawer visibly slides outward during frames 105–123 (image and left_ego_image). The robot then releases and withdraws, leaving the drawer open through frame 156 (image and left_ego_image). No failed acquisition, harmful collision, or disturbance of unrelated tabletop objects is visibly established.
